title: Category 2 test 2 (one-way roads): owner-approved improvements (apply later)
why: Owner, 17 Oct 2026, approved to apply later: (1) any route from any engine or service that drives a one-way road the wrong way is marked FAIL, in test results and by the app's check of received routes; (2) add 'one way except cycles' and other vehicle-specific one-ways to the test cohort; (3) time-limited one-ways evaluated against the clock.
